direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; cols 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge the opening-story logo block slightly and tighten the hero copy so the required second logo placement reads as a deliberate brand moment at 1366x768.
Raise the smallest SVG job and evidence labels to 11px and increase contrast on silverDim text against the dark stage.
Add a visible 2px neon focus ring to evidence rows and link their selection bidirectionally to the 120 and 80 tracks.
Keep Route health pre-flight and Investigation source evidence as two separately headed, separately statused groups with clearer spacing and independent controls.
Make the nonce and identity health states explicit text values rather than implying them from the offline route message.
Enlarge the route selector target to 40px and announce its selected state through aria-live only after investigation starts.
Keep the typed consent form tied directly to the selected path and retain the exact phrase, character count, and disabled Accept state until it matches.
Add stronger selected-path linkage from the comparison card to the matching SVG option chip.
Refit the inspector spacing so all three paths and the full consent field remain visible without internal clipping at 768px height.
Preserve the untracked-until-approval proposal state, but enlarge task pager targets 1, 2, and 3 to at least 40px with clear keyboard focus.
Remove duplication between the inspector Approve control and the action-bar primary by keeping one primary per viewport.
Make the 70-part recovery flow label larger and align it cleanly to the neon route so it does not overlap machine captions.
Strengthen the preview state for CELL-MILL-2 with dashed outline, pattern, and PREVIEW text before the shock is applied, without using stoppedRed yet.
Enlarge the machine selector to 40px and state its invalidation consequence immediately beside the control.
Trim the inspector copy to one instruction and one status sentence to protect viewport fit.
Preserve stoppedRed exclusively on CELL-MILL-2 with STOPPED, OFFLINE-STOPPED, and cross-hatch so the exception remains unmistakable.
Keep pre-flight route health distinct from the reinvestigation task and show nonce and identity checks as named rows with pass or offline text.
Increase contrast on the constrained option chip and ensure no feasible route is drawn through the stopped cell.
Retain the invalidated-prior-acceptance banner beside the fresh typed consent form so the revised approval requirement is explicit.
Give the constrained Split path a hatched, text-labelled disabled treatment that cannot be selected by keyboard.
Refit the comparison cards so finish and incremental values align in tabular columns across all rows.
Keep the 3 blocked prior tasks visually separate from the 3 proposed replacements, with distinct headings, markers, and scroll regions.
Clarify that the approved revised plan coexists with replacement tasks awaiting approval, using one concise status line in the action bar.
Enlarge proposal pager and task rows to 40px and add a focus ring that remains visible against the neon selected outline.
Sequence Verify ledger, separate passphrase sealing, and independent checkpoint retention as numbered, gated steps with disabled states explained in text.
Enlarge passphrase guidance and input text to at least 13px while keeping the full checklist visible inside the inspector.
Align the 70, 35h, and 48h proof metrics on one baseline with tabular numerals.
Add a clear completed-state summary in the action bar while removing any active primary that could imply further required work.
Mark all three retained-evidence items Complete with icon, pattern, and text, and make each row keyboard inspectable.
Keep the final factory state static with red only on CELL-MILL-2 and no route through it, preserving the sealed packet message.
